title: METAR / SPECI observations
description: Surface observations as raw METAR and SPECI text, one line per report. The raw text must follow the METAR format; times are UTC. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

reports.description: Raw METAR or SPECI lines, oldest first. Each follows the METAR format exactly

examples: KILN 211853Z 24012G22KT 3SM +TSRA BKN025CB 24/22 A2992 RMK AO2 TSB45 SLP128 P0042 T02440222
KILN 211853Z 24012G22KT 3SM +TSRA BKN025CB 24/22 A2992 RMK AO2 TSB45 SLP128 P0042 T02440222

note.description: Optional note under the observations (decoded summary)
examples: Thunderstorm with heavy rain began at 1845Z; ceiling 2,500 feet.
